summary: Seoul, South Korea. c 1951. In recaptured Seoul, two young Korean boys wait by a jeep as three unidentified members of the 3rd Battalion, The Royal Australian Regiment (3RAR), try to question them with the aid of a traveller's phrase book. In the background is a building which was formerly a civic pride of the Korean capital, but which is now a burned out shell after repeated batterings from both
